summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that it will present new research data at CHEST 2026, the American College of Chest Physicians annual meeting, on its sputum-based tests in development to characterize lung inflammation and detect protein biomarkers, including biologic drug targets for asthma and COPD. The tests are investigational, unvalidated and not FDA-cleared. A press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, stakeholder, pricing or structural terms are present; this is a product-science disclosure, not a special situation.
